values.meaning: Living Shadow cooldown reduction per champion hit
values.quote: reduced by 3 seconds for each enemy {{tip|champion}} hit by '''Zed's''' slash

mechanics.claim: A target can only be damaged by one slash per cast of Shadow Slash, even if hit by multiple overlapping slashes from Zed and his Shadows.
mechanics.quote: a target can only be damaged by one slash per cast of ''Shadow Slash''

mechanics.claim: Being hit by two or more slashes at once applies the enhanced slow instead of dealing extra damage.
mechanics.quote: with {{tt|multiple slashes|See notes}} dealing no additional damage but the slow's effectiveness being increased by 50%

mechanics.claim: Spell shield blocks only one Shadow Slash hit even if multiple hit simultaneously, prioritizing the Shadow's slash over Zed's.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block one ''Shadow Slash'' even if multiple of them hit at the same time, prioritizing blocking the slash from '''Zed's''' ... ''Shadow''

mechanics.claim: Shadow Slash does not interrupt attack, movement, or cast commands, so it does not reset the attack timer.
mechanics.quote: ''Shadow Slash'' does not interrupt attack, movement, or cast commands.
